routes.name: Residencia permanente – nacionales de los Estados Partes del Mercosur y Estados Asociados (art. 33 lit. B)

note: Uruguay, read in the Migration Law (Ley Nº 18.250 of 6 January 2008) as kept up to date by IMPO, the official gazette's legal database, on 2026-10-30 (article 33 as worded by Ley Nº 20.075 of 20 October 2022). Nationals of the Mercosur States Parties and Associated States are permanent residents on proving that nationality; they apply to the Ministry of the Interior or a Uruguayan consulate, and the Ministry decides within ninety working days. They may instead ask for temporary residence. Temporary residence is for a foreigner coming to carry on an activity for a set time, artists among the activities the law names; its holders may come and go freely while it lasts. The law sets no term, fee or tie to an employer for it ('either' and 'any' are the game's readings, the law saying neither), and the regulations (Decretos 312/015 and 45/023) and the Ministry's and the Foreign Ministry's pages weren't read. Naturalisation (legal citizenship under the Constitution) isn't written.
